analyst.summary: Petronet LNG runs the large majority of India's LNG import infrastructure and remains highly profitable and conservatively financed. Headline revenue has been falling, but that mostly reflects lower global LNG prices flowing through the company's pass-through pricing model rather than weaker demand - profit and margins have actually improved in the latest results. A couple of procedural items (a compliance notice from the exchanges, uncertainty around a supplier's force-majeure status) are worth watching but not yet material. We rate it a Hold: a high-quality, cash-generative infrastructure business at a reasonable valuation, without a clear catalyst for a stronger call today.
